label: Trump-aligned
definition: “Trump conservative” or will stand with Trump, but no explicit Trump endorsement.
notes: No endorsement claimed; if there is one, use trump_endorsed.

label: Party endorsement
definition: Endorsed by a party organization.

label: Union endorsed
definition: Endorsed by one or more unions.

label: Other endorsement
definition: Other politician or group endorses the candidate.
notes: Not Trump, a party or a union; those have their own tags.

label: Anti-left
definition: “Radical left”, “Washington liberals”, “woke mob”.

label: “Conservative values”
definition: “Conservative values”, faith, “our freedoms”, Second Amendment.
notes: Includes “constitutional freedoms” and “protect our freedoms” when framed against government overreach.

label: Bipartisan
definition: Candidate works across the aisle.

label: Anti-MAGA
definition: Candidate fights “MAGA”, or rival fails to.
notes: Trump isn’t the subject; if he is, use stand_up_to_trump.

label: Stand up to Trump
definition: Opposes Trump or his policies by name, “stand up to Trump”.

label: Cost of living
definition: Costs are too high and the candidate will lower them, or rival will not.

label: Tax cuts
definition: Candidate supports tax cuts.

label: Housing
definition: Housing costs, rent prices, evictions.

label: Social Security
definition: Defending or expanding Social Security.

label: Wages
definition: Increasing wages, raising the minimum wage.

label: Other economy
definition: Candidate will generally strengthen the economy.
notes: Catch-all for economic messages the other economy tags don’t cover.

label: Medicare
definition: Defending or expanding Medicare.

label: Drug prices
definition: Reduce or cap drug prices, stand up to Big Pharma.

label: Other healthcare
definition: Candidate will generally improve healthcare.
notes: Not Medicare or drug prices; those have their own tags.

label: Border / immigration
definition: “Secure the border”, “illegals”, deportation.

label: ICE
definition: Mentions ICE by name.
notes: ICE named explicitly, in either direction.

label: Corporate greed
definition: Wall Street, Big Tech, Big Pharma, price-gouging.

label: Anti-corruption
definition: “Work for you, not insiders”, Congressional stock trading bans.

label: Billionaires
definition: Mentions billionaires or the ultra-wealthy.

label: “Innovation”
definition: “Unleash American innovation”, promotes tech development and investment.

label: AI safety
definition: AI needs to be regulated.

label: AI & jobs
definition: AI threatens jobs and workers.

label: Mentions industry
definition: Ad mentions the sponsor’s industry: crypto or digital assets for crypto PACs, AI for AI PACs.

label: Mentions tech
definition: “Big Tech”, specific tech companies or executives, or mentions tech broadly.
notes: Includes AI or crypto when it isn’t the sponsor’s industry. Mutually exclusive with mentions_industry.

label: Democracy / rights
definition: “Defend democracy”; protect civil, voting rights.
notes: Generic “freedom” or “constitutional freedoms” framed against government overreach goes to conservative_values. Tag bare “our rights” by the rest of the ad, not the sponsor’s party.

label: National security
definition: Candidate supports military, “stand up to China”, believes America must lead other countries in tech development.

label: Women’s rights
definition: Reproductive freedom, maternal rights, Roe v. Wade.

label: Infrastructure
definition: Candidate brings federal money home; roads, hospitals.

label: Energy
definition: “Energy dominance”, oil and gas policy.

label: Rural policy
definition: Candidate fights for farmers, ranchers, and rural communities.

label: Public safety
definition: Law enforcement, gun violence.

label: Deregulation
definition: Regulations should be cut.

label: AI as a national asset
definition: AI development is a race America must win.

label: AI needs safeguards
definition: AI can be a risk to people, jobs, or security; candidate wants rules.

label: Tech as the opponent
definition: Big Tech is the enemy: us vs. them.

label: Opponent tied to tech
definition: Rival is bought by tech money or tied to tech companies.

label: Humble origins
definition: Worked through school, held blue-collar jobs, raised by single parent, “self-made”.
notes: Also counts parents with ordinary jobs.

label: Business owner
definition: Built or ran a business, “businessman”.

label: Veteran
definition: Served in the military.

label: Family
definition: Emphasizes that candidate is a mother/father/wife/husband, “family man”.

label: Rural roots
definition: Farmer, rancher, rural origins.

label: Union ties
definition: Union member.

label: Attacks character
definition: Opponent is corrupt, hypocritical, scandal-tainted, an outsider, or hiding their true beliefs.
notes: Ad is primarily negative about the opponent.

label: Attacks funding
definition: Opponent is bought by donors or dark money.
notes: Ad is primarily negative about the opponent.

label: Attacks record
definition: Criticizes opponent’s voting record or policy positions.
notes: Ad is primarily negative about the opponent.

label: Issue ad
definition: Ad asks viewers to call or thank their representative rather than vote.

label: Influencer video
definition: Ad is a long-form creator video.

label: Other party’s candidate
definition: Ad backs a candidate from the other party than the committee’s.
